summary: Etsy client: auto rate ceiling (4.5 rps or 0.9x observed x-limit-per-second), immediate daily-quota RateLimitedError on 429 with x-remaining-today 0, and masking of the composed keystring:secret and raw shared secret.
reason: internal/cliutil is generator-reserved, so the ceiling is applied in client.New. Daily exhaustion cannot recover through retry waits. The wire credential is keystring:secret and was not covered by the generated mask.
